title: Deductibles and Roof Loss Settlement Age — HomeShield Programs
content:
Each HomeShield program of Homeowners Insurance sets three deductibles and one roof age. The all-other-perils deductible is a flat dollar figure. The wind and hail deductible and the named-storm deductible for coastal communities are percentages of Coverage A. The roof age is the age, in years, after which roof losses settle at actual cash value.

## Deductible schedule

| Program | All-other-perils deductible (USD) | Wind and hail deductible | Named-storm deductible, coastal communities | Roof age for actual cash value settlement |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| HomeShield Essential | 2,500 (2500) | 2 percent of Coverage A | 5 percent of Coverage A | 15 years |
| HomeShield Standard | 2,000 (2000) | 2 percent of Coverage A | 5 percent of Coverage A | 15 years |
| HomeShield Plus | 1,500 (1500) | 1 percent of Coverage A | 5 percent of Coverage A | 15 years |
| HomeShield Preferred | 1,000 (1000) | 1 percent of Coverage A | 2 percent of Coverage A | 15 years |
| HomeShield Premier | 2,500 (2500) | 1 percent of Coverage A | 2 percent of Coverage A | 15 years |
| HomeShield Estate | 5,000 (5000) | 1 percent of Coverage A | 2 percent of Coverage A | 15 years |

The all-other-perils deductible does not fall steadily with the program: HomeShield Preferred has the lowest, at 1,000 dollars, while HomeShield Premier returns to 2,500 dollars and HomeShield Estate is the highest at 5,000 dollars.

## Percentage deductibles in dollars

A percentage deductible is that percentage of the policy's Coverage A, not of the amount of the loss.

**Worked illustration (hypothetical Coverage A).**

| Program | Hypothetical Coverage A (USD) | Wind and hail deductible (USD) | Named-storm deductible (USD) |
|---|---|---|---|
| HomeShield Standard | 400,000 | 2 percent, 8,000 | 5 percent, 20,000 |
| HomeShield Preferred | 700,000 | 1 percent, 7,000 | 2 percent, 14,000 |

## Roof age

The roof age figure is 15 years in every program: roof losses settle at replacement cost until the roof is 15 years old, and at actual cash value after that age.
